lines.prompt: Minimize the critical path depth of the design, ensuring the netlist remains AND and NOT only. Make sure nothing changes functionally. The cost function is the maximum logic depth of the final design; smaller is better.

golden.reference: Best final max logic depth = 15 (derived from Team4/Team7 score arithmetic). Response must claim depth reduction, AND/NOT-only basis retained, and functional equivalence.
golden.notes: Relative QoR line: score ~ best_depth/team_depth. Anchor best_depth=15 is derived from the two reliable-team equations agreeing: Team7 depth 17 with credit 0.88 (15/17=0.882) and Team4 depth 21 with credit 0.71 (15/21=0.714). Team3 logs depth 19 but earned 0.56, and 15/0.56~=26.8, so Team3's measured depth on its written test49_out.v was ~27; a checker should measure depth on the output file, not trust the log. Team2's log (a different run than its graded one; its listed score is not evidence) also reports depth 15, consistent with the derived anchor but not used to set it. Starting depths differ (43-51) because they are measured after each team's own line-4 remap.
